buatkan /vidabotest untuk melakukan generate menggunakan vidabot dimana user akan memasukkan gambar dan prompt nya seperti di /grok

berikut post request postnya beserta cookie nya:
POST /api/veo/video-generate HTTP/2
Host: vidabot.markasai.com
Cookie: remember_web_%3D; XSRF-%3D; laravel_%3D
Content-Length: 235331
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not;A=Brand";v="8", "Chromium";v="150"
Content-Type: application/json
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/150.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Origin: https://vidabot.markasai.com
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors
Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty
Referer: https://vidabot.markasai.com/public/app/generate-veo3
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Priority: u=1, i

{"mode":"i2v_start","prompts":[{"text":"STRICTLY Android tablet device, NOT a laptop, NOT a MacBook, NOT a clamshell device, tablet form only, no hinge, no folding body, detachable wired keyboard clearly separate, visible cable connection, external mouse visible when needed, dynamic cinematic motion for product-focused video, starting with macro close-up then transitioning into wider product view, hands interacting naturally (typing, tapping, unplugging cable, sliding object), smooth but fast pacing, jump cuts every 0.5–1 second, camera movements include push-in, pull-out, slight rotation, snap zoom, and angle switching (top view, side view, macro detail), emphasize tactile interaction timing with cuts, maintain clean composition with product always as focal point, lighting shifts subtly to highlight different features, high contrast and depth of field, premium tech advertisement feel, include micro satisfying actions: tap, swipe, click, plug-in, unplug, slide, lid opening, cursor movement, each action synced with quick cuts, fast pacing, high energy but controlled rhythm, combine quick cuts with micro pauses (0.3–0.5 seconds), scroll stopping visuals, smooth transitions that follow hand motion"}],"aspectRatio":"portrait","images":[{"base64":"","fileName":"ChatGPT Image Jun 1, 2026, 07_05_06 PM.png","mimeType":"image/jpeg"}]}
